# Enamel Dentistry

> > Enamel Dentistry is a multi-location dental practice in Austin and McKinney, Texas, offering comprehensive general, cosmetic, restorative, and specialized dental services.

Enamel Dentistry operates 10 locations across the Austin metropolitan area and McKinney, providing family dentistry, preventive care, cosmetic treatments, and specialized services like implants, orthodontics, and sleep apnea treatment. The practice features experienced dentists including Dr. Ravin Chodavadia, Dr. Dillon Patel, Dr. Jade Wylie, Dr. Jennifer Chau, and Dr. Sareena Gillani.

## Key Topics

- General Dentistry
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Dental Implants
- Preventive Care
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Restorative Dentistry
- Invisalign
- Sleep Apnea Treatment
- TMJ/TMD Treatment
- Periodontal Care
- Oral Cancer Screening
- Austin Dentistry
- McKinney Dentistry
- Family Dentistry
- Dental Crowns

## Restorative & General Services

- [Preventative Dental Care](https://enameldentistry.com/preventive-dental-care): Preventive dental care and teeth cleaning services at Enamel Dentistry in Austin.
- [Composite Fillings](https://enameldentistry.com/composite-fillings): Composite fillings for cavity repair and tooth restoration at Enamel Dentistry.
- [Dental Crowns and Bridges](https://enameldentistry.com/dental-crowns): Dental crowns and bridges for tooth restoration at Enamel Dentistry Austin.
- [Tooth Extractions](https://enameldentistry.com/tooth-extractions): Wisdom teeth removal and tooth extraction services at Enamel Dentistry Austin.

- [Oral Cancer Screening](https://enameldentistry.com/oral-cancer-screening): Oral cancer screening and early detection services at Enamel Dentistry Austin.

- [TMJ/TMD Treatment](https://enameldentistry.com/tmj): TMJ/TMD treatment for jaw pain and teeth grinding at Enamel Dentistry Austin.
